business_problem: GetGo Carsharing needed fresher analytics across bookings, fueling, and fleet operations because its legacy setup made it slow and expensive to launch new insights and detect fraud or maintenance issues.
solution_summary: GetGo Carsharing uses Databricks Data + AI Platform, Delta Lake, Databricks SQL, and Unity Catalog to support car-sharing analytics, fraud detection, and fleet insights. GetGo Carsharing needed fresher analytics across bookings, fueling, and fleet operations because its legacy setup made it slow and expensive to launch new insights and detect fraud or maintenance issues. In practice, the implementation stores or organizes core datasets in Delta Lake, governs access and lineage with Unity Catalog, coordinates repeatable workflows with Lakeflow, runs transformation or AI logic on Databricks Data + AI Platform, and delivers outputs through Databricks SQL. Transaction, claims, risk, and event data are consolidated into Delta Lake; pipeline execution is coordinated with Lakeflow; Databricks Data + AI Platform applies analytics or model logic; results are surfaced through Databricks SQL.
